description: This Clothespin Bag is durable and can hold up to 24 clothes pins. Hanging steel hook attaches easily on clothesline.
Clothespin Bag made from durable TNT Non-woven material. Easy access to clothespins when hanging items on clothesline.

This multipurpose clothespin bag can be used indoors and outdoors to help eliminate laundry clutter. Includes a hanging steel hook that allows you to place this bag on a clothesline or wherever it’s convenient and within arms reach.
Dimensions: 13(L) x 11(W) x 0.1(H) inches Holds: 24 Clothespins Color: White Material: TNT Non-Woven Material
